name: Trollbeads

prices.note: products.json (USD) beads collection, 951 products: 927 regular-price available, 0 marked down. Classic silver and glass beads from $39 (From the Heart, Silver Bead; Hourglass Bead) to 2 + 2 Bead $787 (retired 2013) and Ruby Bead with Gold Core $430. Vine of Dreams glass bead $49; faceted beads mostly $75.

notes: FAQ: head office in Copenhagen, Denmark; returns within 30 days of delivery from within the US, $6.99 handling fee deducted. 'We have experienced that beads from other brands fit on our chains but not the other way around.' Craftsmanship: each bead is handmade, so unique in size, colour and pattern; most are silver, plus Murano glass.

Shipping policy: free standard US shipping over $149, else $6.99; also ships to the Caribbean, Mexico, Central and South America ($11.99 under $149). meta.json lists more countries, but the policy names only the Americas, so only US stored.
